reading: A row both signals call plain draws one structure and can be read off. A row both call marked does not: the document states a mass change and the region it happened in, so what it publishes is a formula and a neighbourhood, and a single structure read from it would be a position nobody measured. Where the two signals differ the row is listed and left undecided, because an abbreviation such as GluA is sometimes bonded to a drawn atom and sometimes to a dashed box, and only looking tells which.
